title: How does an owner set up a monthly transfer that puts back what overdraft protection took from a Savings & Money Market Accounts account?
content:
## Situation and policy

This policy applies when the owner of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account asks for a monthly automatic transfer that puts back what overdraft protection took from the savings account in a statement cycle, together with the withdrawal fees the account bears for that cycle.

- The monthly amount of the instruction is the replenishment amount this policy sets.
- The funding checking account, the transfer day from 1 to 28 and the rest of the owner's instruction follow the automatic transfer rules of Savings & Money Market Accounts unchanged.

## Business effect

One call records the instruction on the savings account: the fixed monthly amount, the day of the month it runs and the checking account it is drawn from, replacing any earlier instruction. The transfer first runs on the next occurrence of that day. The savings account lookup then shows the new amount, day and funding checking account.

## How it is invoked

The tool is set_savings_automatic_transfer_e1e909eb. It is a customer-side tool: it must first be unlocked and handed over, to be run by the customer themselves, as the owner's own instruction about their money.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| savings_account_id | the reference number of the savings or money market account that receives the transfers, as returned by the savings account lookup | identifier |
| funding_checking_account_id | the reference number of the customer's own checking account the transfers are drawn from, as returned by the checking account lookup | identifier |
| automatic_transfer_amount | the fixed monthly transfer amount | USD, 2 decimal places, positive |
| automatic_transfer_day | the day of the month the transfer runs | an integer from 1 to 28, or an empty string when there is none; pass the integer day |

The tool records the values it is given; it does not work out the amount or check the funding account.

## Return

A successful call returns a receipt with savings_account_id (the receiving account), automatic_transfer_amount (USD with 2 decimal places), automatic_transfer_day (an integer from 1 to 28) and funding_checking_account_id (the funding checking account). A receipt echoing the requested amount and day means the instruction is recorded.

## Contract Q&A

**Does a new call add a second transfer?** No; it replaces any earlier instruction on the account.

**When does the first transfer run?** On the next occurrence of the chosen day.

**Illustrative call (hypothetical values):** savings_account_id of the account, funding_checking_account_id of the owner's checking account, automatic_transfer_amount 180.00 and automatic_transfer_day 15; the receipt echoes 180.00 and 15.
